mainEntity.name: How often should indoor plants be watered in Pakistan?

acceptedAnswer.text: Check the soil instead of following a fixed calendar. Water when the top layer feels dry, and reduce watering during cooler months or when the soil stays wet longer.

mainEntity.name: How can I protect plants during Pakistan's summer?

acceptedAnswer.text: Keep sensitive plants away from harsh afternoon sun, water deeply when the soil needs it, improve airflow, and use mulch for outdoor pots to slow moisture loss.

mainEntity.name: Why do plant leaves turn yellow?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common causes include overwatering, poor drainage, low light, root stress, and nutrient problems. Check soil moisture and drainage before adding fertilizer.

mainEntity.name: Which indoor plants are easiest for beginners?

acceptedAnswer.text: Snake plant, money plant, aloe vera, and several pothos varieties are popular beginner choices when they receive suitable light and are not overwatered.
